title: Witness each arm of the closing-checkpoint retry exception and anchor its ordering checks at the park
outcome: The scope-guard witness in src/tests/engram_closing_checkpoint_retry.rs swaps in a grant with no checkpoint card, so a regression dropping the continuation_id or authority comparison would pass. Predicate-level witnesses cover a newer non-Degraded checkpoint card for the same grant, a cause naming another continuation, a different authority, a refused cause (per its sibling item) and an uncertain grant. The ordering checks assert on the operation log after the park (not rposition over the whole log), and raw turn_checkpoint sends are counted there.
acceptance: Tests fail if any one comparison in engram_unsettled_closing_checkpoint_holds (stage, grant, decision, operation, continuation_id, authority) or the uncertain-grant exclusion is removed, and the ordering witnesses assert on the slice of operations after the park, counting raw recovery checkpoint sends.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
